# dashboard-notice-bus

createNoticeBus() creates a synchronous single-channel bus. on(fn) adds one subscription and returns an idempotent unsubscribe function. Each emit(value) takes a snapshot of subscriptions present at its start and calls each in registration order with that value. Removing or adding a subscription during a callback affects later emits only. Even an entry removed during this emit must still receive this value if it was in the snapshot. Duplicate registrations are independent. No callback in the supported inputs throws. emit and unsubscribe return values are unspecified.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Keep the public API and tests/ unchanged. Use Node built-ins only; no packages or network.
